target_forcefield: CHARMM36 additive plus compatible CGenFF terms
visual_review_scope: absence of reflection or endpoint exchange
chemical relevance of proposed coupled conformers
visual_review_exclusions: bond, angle, dihedral, or improper force-constant acceptance

requirements: hash-pinned atom order, elements, molecular graph, and reference minimum
all four product signed-volume stereocenters retain their declared sign
alignment uses a proper rotation with no reflection
each candidate is distinct from the minimum and every other candidate
both signs of each of the two highest-active-fraction normal modes are retained
training and validation each contain one sign of every selected mode
fixed-geometry QM must not optimize the candidate before force/Hessian evaluation

proper_rotation_aligned_rmsd_angstrom.role: Reject numerical duplicates and gross distortions; not an equilibrium-geometry target.

graph_bond_length_ratio_to_qm_minimum.role: Catastrophic-input screen for intentionally displaced structures, not a force-field acceptance tolerance.

minimum_nonbonded_covalent_radius_ratio.role: PoseBusters-inspired severe internal-overlap screen; bonded and 1-3 pairs are excluded.

requirements: RDKit sanitization succeeds for the explicit Lewis structure
stable atom map is bijective and matches the XYZ and SDF atom order
exactly 63 atoms and formal charge -1 for the declared d(TpT) cap model
both terminal hydroxyl caps, the inter-residue phosphodiester, both glycosidic bonds, and both CPD crosslinks are present
phosphorus stereochemistry is unspecified for the resonance-equivalent nonbridging oxygens
all four product signed-volume stereocenters retain their declared sign
two independent 1N4E copies agree after proper-rotation heavy-atom alignment without reflection

hard_failures: missing or duplicate stable atom identity
pair charge not conserved within 1e-6 elementary charge
missing expected product bond or duplicate product bond
missing required product atom type, charge, bonded term, improper, or parameter
unexpected stereochemical inversion, reflection, or endpoint exchange
imaginary vibrational mode at the declared optimized minimum
failed 2 fs explicit-solvent NAMD smoke test

water_interaction_energy_rmse_kcal_mol.role: CHARMM target accuracy; evaluate training and held-out probes separately

water_interaction_distance_rmse_angstrom.role: CHARMM target accuracy after the protocol's -0.2 angstrom QM distance offset

dipole_component_sigma_debye.role: NADOC provisional objective scale, not a literature universal cutoff

esp.target: report training and held-out RMSE and improvement over the initial transferable-charge baseline
esp.role: diagnostic until an independently reviewed target-specific cutoff is preregistered

small_distortion_energy_kcal_mol.role: ffTK/CHARMM objective scale for bond and angle distortions

requirements: fit the coupled internal-coordinate response, not isolated force constants
weight low-frequency product-ring modes explicitly
demonstrate held-out coupled-conformer performance
reject non-identifiable parameter bases
fit the QM/MM potential-energy-surface difference
use CHARMM-compatible phases and justified multiplicities
preserve minima ordering and accessible barriers
reevaluate after charge or other bonded-term changes
reserve coupled conformers for validation

validation_targets.role: Preregistered NADOC targets informed by modern force-field benchmarking; failures require model revision, not threshold relaxation.

requirements: all explicit-solvent NAMD energies and forces finite
exact PSF bond/type/charge/improper and reverse-identity audit
stereochemistry retained through staged minimization and 2 fs dynamics
no systematic lesion/backbone instability attributable to setup
compare solution ensembles with experimental observables when available
paired reactant/product simulations use matched protocols

literature_correction_sequence.trigger: candidate-v3 generic cyclobutane transfer diverges from the CPD-specific Ma/van der Vaart comparison and produces an asymmetric C6-C6 trajectory distribution
required_candidate_variants: complete CPD ring-block refit against the existing coupled QM response evidence
Ma/van der Vaart published-table reconstruction used as a comparison model only when every applied term can be represented without inventing unavailable topology information

forbidden: repairing only the long C6-C6 bond
retaining a covered generic ring term outside the refit without a documented sensitivity comparison
using a crystal or literature equilibrium value as an unoptimized force-field parameter

requirements: minimize every training and held-out conformer in the candidate MM model
compare both crosslinks, both retained C5-C6 bonds, four ring angles, ring puckering, glycosidic bonds, and all stereochemical signed volumes
compare low-frequency ring modes or an equivalent mass-weighted Hessian projection
report relative energies without interpreting the neutral N-methyl gas-phase ordering as DNA isomer populations

explicit_solution_validation.salt: recorded physiological monovalent salt; use 0.15 M NaCl for literature comparison unless the experimental construct requires another condition
observables: Watson-Crick hydrogen-bond occupancy and asymmetric 5-prime/3-prime opening
local stacking, twist, roll, bend, unwinding, groove widths, and 3-prime backbone BI/BII state
finite energies and absence of systematic setup-driven instability

literature_correction_sequence.family_extension: Every other ordered TT-CPD form requires its own MM-vs-QM and engine audits. Sharing a parameter block requires a passed atom-mapped equivalence or joint-fit validation; stereochemical labels alone are insufficient.

decision_rule: A parameter set is releasable only when every hard gate passes, all preregistered quantitative target and held-out checks pass, and known limitations are recorded. Passing an automated QM-input screen only authorizes evidence generation; it does not release parameters. Visual approval alone never releases parameters.
